# CucumberGherkin v41.0.0 - Table of Contents

## Modules

- [CucumberGherkin](https://cucumber-gherkin.hexdocs.pm/CucumberGherkin.md): `CucumberGherkin` allows you to parse Gherkin files to pickles (or tokens). These pickles can be used in a cucumber implementation.
- [CucumberGherkin.Line](https://cucumber-gherkin.hexdocs.pm/CucumberGherkin.Line.md)
- [CucumberGherkin.ParserContext](https://cucumber-gherkin.hexdocs.pm/CucumberGherkin.ParserContext.md)
